Hi Enzo,

UTE's public list includes P103888, the Third 500 kV Chamberlain-Cardal-Pando corridor, with an opening date of 25 January 2027. An official Uruguayan resolution also authorises foreign-company participation, but the detailed lots, prequalification and local-delivery rules still need pack review.

INGESAT SIMM's published 525 kV substation, protection/control and field-commissioning capabilities look relevant to a specialist workstream. I can build a line/substation/protection interface matrix and qualify the missing EPC and Uruguay-delivery roles before any introduction.

Could you confirm whether this is within your development remit, or refer me to the appropriate technical/commercial owner? No partner commitment, mandate, fee or claim of bid eligibility is assumed.
